title: Wisdom of the Crowd, Without the Crowd: A Socratic LLM for Asynchronous Deliberation on Perspectivist Data

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing annotation label flips, post-deliberation accuracy, and annotator confidence using a Socratic LLM against a synchronous human deliberation baseline to evaluate how well individual divergent perspectives are preserved rather than collapsed into unitary 'ground truth' labels.

Qualitative thematic analysis of conversation logs between annotators and the Socratic LLM to observe whether the LLM acts as an impartial facilitator or if it amplifies training data biases by overly pressuring annotators to abandon legitimate, non-standard minority perspectives.
